work.description: The act announces his accession, reviews current errors and charges the bishops to defend doctrine and form the clergy. Dating LF1018-1020 reads: Datum Romae apud Sanctam Mariam Majorem die IX Novembris Ànno MDCCCXLVI Pontificatus Nostri Ànno Primo.
